name: security-sentinel
description: Proactive security auditor and secret leak prevention system. Blocks hardcoded API keys, detects OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, audits dependencies for CVEs, and enforces zero-trust security best practices.
suggestedPrompts: Audit my codebase for hardcoded secrets, API keys, and sensitive tokens
Perform an OWASP Top 10 vulnerability scan across my API routes and data queries
Audit my package dependencies for known CVE vulnerabilities and recommend safe updates
